conventions: TypeScript strict; ESM; prettier 2.6 via @excalidraw/prettier-config (80 cols, double quotes, trailing commas); eslint runs with --max-warnings=0 so import-order warnings fail.

Import order: external packages, then @excalidraw/* (own group after other externals), then parent/sibling imports, then `import type` lines; groups separated by a blank line; type-only imports are separate `import type` statements.

Inside packages/excalidraw never import from the @excalidraw/excalidraw barrel, `..` or `../index`; import the module directly. Cross-package imports use @excalidraw/common, @excalidraw/element, @excalidraw/element/types, @excalidraw/common/utility-types.
jotai only through ../editor-jotai (packages/excalidraw) or ./app-jotai (excalidraw-app); never import jotai directly.
Use app.ownerDocument / app.ownerWindow (or a node's ownerDocument), never the document/window globals, in new editor code.

Immutable updates: spread appState ({ ...appState, field }); never mutate elements except through newElementWith / mutateElement / Scene APIs; the one sanctioned exception is stampElementsPage (packages/element/src/pages.ts) setting pageId on freshly created elements before they enter the scene.
Prefer Merge<> from @excalidraw/common/utility-types over Omit<> & ...; prefer const/readonly, ?. and ??, and no per-frame allocation.
New UI strings go only in packages/excalidraw/locales/en.json under the `pages` key; components read them with t("pages.<key>") from ../i18n.
A component has a sibling .scss imported last as a side effect (import "./PageTabs.scss"); class names are composed with clsx; tests target data-testid attributes.
Actions are register({...}) consts; name added to the ActionName union in actions/types.ts; re-exported from actions/index.ts; App registers them through actionManager.registerAll(actions).

Tests: vitest globals (describe/it/expect/vi); editor tests render <Excalidraw /> via render from tests/test-utils, drive with Pointer/UI/Keyboard from tests/helpers/ui, build fixtures with API from tests/helpers/api, assert through window.h (h.state, h.elements, h.app, h.history). Pure tests in packages/element/tests import from ../src/<module>.
Snapshot files (__snapshots__/**) are never typed by a unit; they are regenerated only by the yarn test:update tooling unit.
Page names are user content: never console.log or otherwise log a page name or element text.

decisions.topic: Page model storage (FIXED by the person at the architecture retry; not re-litigated)
decisions.choice: Page membership is an optional `pageId` on every element; the page list lives in AppState as ordered `pages: ExcalidrawPage[]` with `{ id, name, version, versionNonce, isDeleted }` (FR-20a) plus the order key `index`; one `elements` array stays in the file, socket payloads, Firestore and reconciliation.
decisions.reason: The person's decision at the architecture retry: it keeps one element array in every transport and per-element reconciliation unchanged.

decisions.choice: ExcalidrawPage = Readonly<{ id: string; name: string; index: FractionalIndex; version: number; versionNonce: number; isDeleted: boolean }>; the person's five fields are kept verbatim and `index` (fractional-indexing key) is added as the order key; `pages` in AppState is always kept sorted by (index, id) and includes tombstones.
rejected: array position as the only order (two peers appending concurrently would merge in a peer-dependent order, failing AC-9)
decisions.reason: Per-page merge needs an order value that travels with each page; ties on equal index break on id so every peer computes the same order.

decisions.choice: The home page id is DEFAULT_PAGE_ID when appState.pages contains a page with that id (tombstoned or not), else the smallest page id (string order) among all pages incl. tombstones, so reordering or deleting pages never moves it. An element whose pageId is absent, or names no page in appState.pages (tombstones included), belongs to the home page; an element whose pageId names a tombstoned page is hidden with that page. stampElementsPage(elements, options) removes pageId when the active page is the home page and sets pageId = active page id otherwise; it runs only at local creation points: Scene.insertElementsAtIndex (drawing, insertNewElements, Mermaid/TTD), App.addElementsFromPasteOrLibrary (paste, library), and App.updateScene for elements not yet in the scene only when captureUpdate is given and is not CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER and the call carries no appState.pages. Remote/initialization updates (NEVER), whole-scene loads (any updateScene carrying appState.pages, e.g. excalidraw-app onHashChange joining a room, opening a #json= link or returning to the local drawing) and restore never stamp.
rejected: stamp pageId on every element always (churns every element test and snapshot, and every legacy file on first save)
home = first page in order (reorder/delete/undo of the first page would move unstamped elements to another page)
stamp inside Scene.replaceAllElements (would re-home a peer's elements onto the receiver's active page)
stamp every IMMEDIATELY updateScene (a whole-scene load has only new elements and would collapse all pages onto the active one)
decisions.reason: Legacy files and single-page drawings stay byte-identical (NFR-1, A-4), the home page never moves when pages are reordered or deleted, and FR-17/FR-18 hold without rewriting elements.

decisions.choice: DEFAULT_PAGE_ID = "default" in packages/common/src/constants.ts; default page = { id: DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, name: "", index: "a0", version: 1, versionNonce: 0, isDeleted: false }, built by createDefaultPages() in packages/element/src/pages.ts. An empty stored name displays as t("pages.defaultName", { number: position + 1 }); created pages store the localized name at creation.
decisions.reason: Deterministic legacy restore (A-2): every peer and every reload builds the identical default page, so it never conflicts in reconciliation.

decisions.choice: pages: readonly ExcalidrawPage[] (browser true, export true, server false); activePageId: string (browser true, export true, server false); pageViewports: { [pageId: string]: PageViewport } with PageViewport = { scrollX: number; scrollY: number; zoom: Zoom } (browser true, export false, server false).
decisions.reason: pages travel in the file and localStorage; share links (server) export only the active page's elements and restore onto one default page; the active page and viewports are per-client (FR-21) but survive reload.

decisions.choice: Only deletePage is undoable (CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY); createPage, renamePage, reorderPage and switchPage use CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER.
rejected: all operations undoable (a create/rename on page A would sit in page A's stack and undo would flip tabs while drawing)
EVENTUALLY (it folds the page op into the user's next drawing undo)
decisions.reason: FR-11 requires delete undo; keeping the other ops out of history means undo only ever touches drawing work on the active page.

decisions.choice: History keeps one { undo, redo } stack pair per page id; `undoStack`/`redoStack` become getters for the active page's pair; record() pushes to the active page; undo/redo push the inverse entry onto the stack of the page that is active after the entry was applied, and switch History to that page.
rejected: clear history on every page switch (loses undo when coming back)
one shared stack filtered at undo time
decisions.reason: Undo never alters another page's elements, each page keeps its own undo, and delete -> undo -> redo works because the redo entry lands on the restored page.

decisions.topic: pages and activePageId in the store
decisions.choice: pages and activePageId join ObservedStandaloneAppState as optional keys (getObservedAppState always sets them; optional keeps hand-written ObservedAppState literals in existing tests valid); AppStateDelta post-processes pages to only the pages whose name/index/isDeleted changed (by id), and applies them per id with version + 1 and a fresh versionNonce (applyPageChanges) instead of replacing the array; squash merges pages by id.
decisions.reason: Undo of a delete must propagate to peers (bumped version wins reconciliation, FR-20a) and must not drop pages a peer created meanwhile.

decisions.choice: Scene.setActivePage(options: ScenePageOptions | null) with ScenePageOptions = { activePageId, homePageId, pageIds: ReadonlySet<string>, isSinglePage } built by the memoized getScenePageOptions(pages, activePageId); Scene recomputes its active-page caches and regenerates sceneNonce only when it receives a different options object, and on every replaceAllElements. getNonDeletedElements, getNonDeletedElementsMap, getNonDeletedFramesLikes and getSelectedElements return the active page only; getElementsIncludingDeleted / getElementsMapIncludingDeleted / getFramesIncludingDeleted stay all pages. With options null (a Scene the editor never set, e.g. export or element-package tests) or a single page, the active caches are the all-page caches (no copy).
decisions.reason: Renderers, hit-testing, selection, frames, bindings and snapping already read those getters, so they become page-scoped without per-consumer changes and without per-frame filtering.

decisions.choice: ActionManager's element getter is scene.getActivePageElementsIncludingDeleted(); syncActionResult writes result elements through scene.mergeActivePageElements(elements) (slot fill: every position in the current array that holds an active-page element or an id present in the result is refilled, in order, from the result; other pages' elements keep their positions untouched; leftover result elements are appended) unless the result sets `allPages: true`, which replaces every element. allPages is set by actionLoadScene, App's initial-data load and file-open/drop loads, actionDeletePage, and undo/redo (which run History over every page's elements). File save (saveToActiveFile, saveFileToDisk) serializes app.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted(), not the action's page-scoped elements.
rejected: pass all elements to actions (selectAll, zoomToFit, clearCanvas, unlockAll and export would act on hidden pages)
decisions.reason: Every existing action becomes page-scoped by construction, which also makes image/clipboard export cover the active page only (FR-12).

decisions.topic: Where the active page is synced
decisions.choice: App.render() calls a private syncScenePage(state) first: it calls scene.setActivePage(getScenePageOptions(state.pages, state.activePageId)); Scene.setActivePage never invokes onUpdate callbacks (no setState in render) and regenerates sceneNonce only when the active page really changed. History follows in componentDidUpdate: history.setActivePage(scene.getActivePageId()) runs right before store.commit, so a recorded entry lands on the page it was made on.
decisions.reason: Scene must be filtered before the frame renders; History's emitter sets state, which is legal in componentDidUpdate but not in render.

decisions.choice: switchPage stores { scrollX, scrollY, zoom } of the current page in pageViewports[currentPageId], then applies pageViewports[target] or the default { scrollX: 0, scrollY: 0, zoom: { value: 1 } }, and clears selectedElementIds, selectedGroupIds, editingGroupId, selectedLinearElement, editingTextElement, croppingElementId, activeEmbeddable and contextMenu. deletePage of the active page runs the same switch to the neighbour (next, else previous).
decisions.reason: A-1: only scroll and zoom are per page; every other AppState field stays drawing-wide.

decisions.choice: SCENE_INIT and SCENE_UPDATE payloads become { elements, pages? } (pages = every page incl. tombstones, sent on every broadcast); receivers reconcile pages with reconcilePages and elements as today. The Firestore `scenes` document keeps `ciphertext`/`iv` as the encrypted bare element array, byte-compatible with old clients, and gains `pagesCiphertext` and `pagesIv` (Bytes): encryptData(roomKey, UTF-8 JSON.stringify(pages incl. tombstones)) with its own iv; new clients write all five fields on every save (transaction.set for a new document, transaction.update for an existing one); a document lacking pagesCiphertext or pagesIv reads as createDefaultPages(). The stored `sceneVersion`, FirebaseSceneVersionCache and every Collab version comparison use getSceneVersion(elements) + getPagesVersion(pages), so a page-only change (rename, reorder, delete) changes the version and is broadcast and saved.
rejected: a new WS subtype for pages (two messages can arrive out of order and an element could reference a page the peer does not know yet)
{ elements, pages } inside the element ciphertext (old clients JSON.parse it straight into restoreElements and throw, so they could neither load nor save the room)
decisions.reason: Old clients keep loading and saving the bare array, and their transaction.update on an existing room leaves pagesCiphertext/pagesIv in place; firestore.rules has no field validation, so no relay or rules change (NFR-5); pages and their elements arrive atomically over the socket; stored sceneVersion is never read back, so an old client writing the elements-only version is harmless.

decisions.choice: Where the app needs every page's live elements (Collab.startCollaboration for a new room, App.tsx's beforeunload shouldPreventUnload check) it uses getNonDeletedElements(excalidrawAPI.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted()) from @excalidraw/element; getSceneElements() stays the active page. Excalidraw+ export and share-link export keep getSceneElements() (out of scope 7).
rejected: a new public getSceneElementsAllPages API (the existing all-pages getter plus a filter covers it)
decisions.reason: Starting a room must upload and broadcast every page (FR-19), and an image upload pending on a hidden page must still block unload.

decisions.choice: reconcilePages(local, remote): per id the remote page wins unless local.version > remote.version or (equal versions and local.versionNonce <= remote.versionNonce) (the element rule); pages known only on one side are kept; the result is sorted by (index, id). createPage gives index = generateKeyBetween(max index over all pages incl. tombstones, null) and a random id.
decisions.reason: Concurrent creates both survive and sort identically on every peer (AC-9).

decisions.choice: restoreAppState: pages = restorePages(supplied ?? local ?? default) (drop malformed entries, sort, default page when none is non-deleted); activePageId = resolveActivePageId(pages, activePageId); pageViewports keeps only well-formed entries of known page ids. loadFromBlob (file open/drop) passes pages/activePageId from the file or the default page, and pageViewports {}, so a legacy file never inherits the local drawing's pages. restoreElementWithProperties keeps pageId only when it is a non-empty string. An element whose pageId names no page resolves to the home page at runtime and is never dropped.
decisions.reason: A legacy file restores onto exactly the default page with no element rewrites; dangling references fall back, never vanish.

decisions.choice: SearchMenu searches scene.getNonDeletedElementsAllPages(); when the focused match's resolved page (scene.getElementPageId) is not the active page it executes actionSwitchPage with that page id and the focus effect re-runs on activePageId to scroll to the match.
decisions.reason: Search results span pages while the renderer still draws highlights only for the active page.

decisions.choice: PageTabs renders at the bottom of the canvas from LayerUI: one <button role="tab"> per non-deleted page (click switches), a "+" button (createPage), a delete button on the active tab (hidden when one page or view mode), double-click on a tab opens an inline <input aria-label> (Enter/blur commit via renamePage, Escape cancels), Alt+ArrowLeft/Alt+ArrowRight on a focused tab and HTML5 drag-and-drop reorder via reorderPage. In view mode only switching is offered.
decisions.reason: Keyboard-reachable, labelled controls (NFR-7) that jsdom tests can drive without pointer drag.

decisions.choice: A tooling unit runs `yarn test:update` after every code and test unit; new AppState fields churn appState snapshots in history/regression/contextmenu tests.
decisions.reason: NFR-6: snapshots change only through yarn test:update, and the Gate 0 `yarn test:app --watch=false` must pass afterwards.

units.behaviour: Pure page-model helpers: defaults, ordering, home/active page resolution, element membership, stamping, per-page versioned merge, restore sanitizing.
rules: 1. Imports: DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, randomId, randomInteger from @excalidraw/common; generateKeyBetween from @excalidraw/fractional-indexing; types ExcalidrawElement, ExcalidrawPage, FractionalIndex from ./types. No React, no DOM.
2. sortPages returns a new array sorted by index ascending, ties by id ascending (string compare) so every peer orders identically.
3. createDefaultPages returns a fresh [{ id: DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, name: "", index: "a0", version: 1, versionNonce: 0, isDeleted: false }] each call.

4. getHomePageId: DEFAULT_PAGE_ID if any page (deleted or not) has that id, else the smallest id (string compare) among all pages incl. tombstones, else DEFAULT_PAGE_ID. It never depends on page order, so reorder and delete never move the home page.
5. resolveActivePageId: the given id when it names a non-deleted page; else the home page id when that page is non-deleted; else the first non-deleted page id; else DEFAULT_PAGE_ID.

6. getScenePageOptions(pages, activePageId) is memoized on the identity of both arguments (keep the last args and result in module-level variables) and returns { activePageId: resolveActivePageId(...), homePageId: getHomePageId(pages), pageIds: Set of every page id incl. tombstones, isSinglePage: pages.length <= 1 }.
7. getElementPageId(element, options): when options is null return DEFAULT_PAGE_ID; return element.pageId when it is a string present in options.pageIds, otherwise options.homePageId.
8. isElementOnActivePage(element, options): true when options is null or options.isSinglePage, else getElementPageId(element, options) === options.activePageId.

9. stampElementsPage mutates the given fresh elements in place (cast to Mutable): when options is null do nothing; when options.activePageId === options.homePageId delete element.pageId; otherwise set element.pageId = options.activePageId. It never changes version.
10. generatePageIndex(pages) = generateKeyBetween(highest index over all pages incl. tombstones or null, null) cast to FractionalIndex.

11. getReorderedPageIndex(pages, pageId, toPosition): take the sorted non-deleted pages without pageId, clamp toPosition to [0, length], return generateKeyBetween(prev?.index ?? null, next?.index ?? null) where prev = list[toPosition - 1] and next = list[toPosition]; when prev and next share the same index (tie) use generateKeyBetween(prev.index, null) only if next is undefined, else return prev.index (ties sort by id).
12. newPage({ name, pages }) returns { id: randomId(), name, index: generatePageIndex(pages), version: 1, versionNonce: randomInteger(), isDeleted: false }.
13. updatePage(page, updates) returns a new page with the updates, version + 1 and a new randomInteger() versionNonce.

14. reconcilePages(local, remote): per id keep local when local.version > remote.version or (equal versions and local.versionNonce <= remote.versionNonce), else remote; include ids present on only one side; return sortPages(result). Same rule as shouldDiscardRemoteElement in data/reconcile.ts.
15. getPagesVersion(pages) = sum of page.version (0 for an empty or missing list).

16. applyPageChanges(pages, changed): for each changed page, if an existing page has its id replace it with { ...existing, name, index, isDeleted taken from changed, version: max(existing.version, changed.version) + 1, versionNonce: randomInteger() }, else append { ...changed, version: changed.version + 1, versionNonce: randomInteger() }; return sortPages(result).

17. restorePages(input: unknown): keep only objects with a non-empty string id (first occurrence wins), a string name (else ""), a string index (else generate one after the previous kept page), finite version >= 1 (else 1), finite versionNonce (else 0), boolean isDeleted (else false); sort; if no non-deleted page remains return createDefaultPages() plus the kept tombstones. Never throws.

units.behaviour: Scene keeps all pages' elements but serves non-deleted elements, maps, frames and selection for the active page only, cached per update.
rules: 1. New private fields: pageOptions: ScenePageOptions | null = null; activeNonDeletedElements, activeNonDeletedElementsMap, activeNonDeletedFramesLikes, activeElementsIncludingDeleted, initialised to the same values as their all-page counterparts.

2. private updateActivePageCaches(): when pageOptions is null or pageOptions.isSinglePage, point every active field at the all-page field (no copy); otherwise filter nonDeletedElements, nonDeletedFramesLikes and elements with isElementOnActivePage and rebuild the branded NonDeletedSceneElementsMap. When pageOptions is null or isSinglePage just call replaceAllElements(nextElements).

units.behaviour: AppStateDelta diffs, squashes and applies pages per page id with a version bump, so undo/redo of a page deletion propagates and never drops other pages.
rules: 1. private static diffPages(deleted, inserted): when neither side has pages return; map both sides by id; a page present on both sides is kept (as the full record on each side) only when name, index or isDeleted differ; a page only in inserted gets a deleted-side record { ...page, isDeleted: true }; a page only in deleted gets an inserted-side record { ...page, isDeleted: true }; when no pages remain delete the pages key from both partials, else set both to the arrays of kept records.

2. applyTo destructures pages out of this.delta.inserted (so it is not directly applied) and, when defined, sets nextAppState.pages = applyPageChanges(appState.pages, insertedPages); activePageId stays directly applicable.

3. squash merges pages by id when either delta has them: later records (from `delta`) override earlier ones per id on both the deleted and inserted side, into mergedDeleted.pages / mergedInserted.pages.
4. stripStandaloneProps also strips pages and activePageId so the SubtypeOf check holds.

units.behaviour: The five page actions: create, switch, rename, reorder and delete, registered through register().
rules: 1. Export a helper getPageSwitchAppState(appState, targetPageId): Partial<AppState> that stores { scrollX, scrollY, zoom } of appState.activePageId into pageViewports, removes the target's entry and applies it (or scrollX 0, scrollY 0, zoom { value: 1 as NormalizedZoomValue }), sets activePageId = targetPageId, and resets selectedElementIds {}, selectedGroupIds {}, editingGroupId null, selectedLinearElement null, editingTextElement null, croppingElementId null, activeEmbeddable null, searchMatches kept as is.

2. actionCreatePage (name "createPage", label "pages.createPage", trackEvent { category: "canvas" }, viewMode false, predicate !appState.viewModeEnabled): page = newPage({ name: t("pages.defaultName", { number: getNonDeletedPages(appState.pages).length + 1 }), pages: appState.pages }); returns appState { ...getPageSwitchAppState(appState, page.id), pages: sortPages([...appState.pages, page]) }, captureUpdate NEVER.

3. actionSwitchPage (name "switchPage", label "pages.switchPage", viewMode true, trackEvent false): formData is the target page id; returns false when it equals appState.activePageId or names no non-deleted page; else appState getPageSwitchAppState(...), captureUpdate NEVER.

4. actionRenamePage (name "renamePage", label "pages.renamePage", viewMode false, trackEvent false): formData { pageId, name }; trimmed = name.trim(); returns false when trimmed is empty, the page is missing/deleted, or trimmed equals the current name; else pages with updatePage(page, { name: trimmed }), captureUpdate NEVER.

5. actionReorderPage (name "reorderPage", label "pages.reorderPage", viewMode false, trackEvent false): formData { pageId, toPosition } (position among non-deleted pages after removal); returns false when the page is missing or the position is unchanged; else pages = sortPages(pages with updatePage(page, { index: getReorderedPageIndex(appState.pages, pageId, toPosition) })), captureUpdate NEVER.

6. actionDeletePage (name "deletePage", label "pages.deletePage", viewMode false, trackEvent { category: "canvas" }, predicate getNonDeletedPages(appState.pages).length > 1 && !appState.viewModeEnabled): formData pageId (default appState.activePageId); returns false when one non-deleted page remains or the page is missing/deleted. Elements: options = getScenePageOptions(appState.pages, appState.activePageId); every non-deleted element of app.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted() with getElementPageId(el, options) === pageId becomes newElementWith(el, { isDeleted: true }); others unchanged. Pages: updatePage(page, { isDeleted: true }). When pageId is the active page, neighbour = next non-deleted page in order, else previous, and spread getPageSwitchAppState(appState, neighbour.id). Returns { elements, allPages: true, appState, captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY }.
7. Labels and names are i18n keys only; no string literals shown to the user.

units.behaviour: The Firestore scene keeps the encrypted bare element array in ciphertext/iv for old clients and stores the page list in its own encrypted pagesCiphertext/pagesIv fields; a document without them reads as the default page.
rules: 1. FirebaseStoredScene gains optional `pagesCiphertext?: Bytes` and `pagesIv?: Bytes`; sceneVersion, iv and ciphertext keep their names and types.
2. encryptElements and decryptElements stay exactly as today: ciphertext is UTF-8 JSON.stringify of the bare element array.

3. New private encryptPages(key, pages): encryptData(key, UTF-8 JSON.stringify(pages)) returning { ciphertext, iv } like encryptElements; new private decryptPages(data, roomKey): return createDefaultPages() when data.pagesCiphertext or data.pagesIv is missing, else decryptData(pagesIv, pagesCiphertext, roomKey), JSON.parse and restorePages(parsed).

4. One version value = getSceneVersion(elements) + getPagesVersion(pages); FirebaseSceneVersionCache.set(socket, elements, pages) stores it, isSavedToFirebase compares it, createFirebaseSceneDocument writes it to sceneVersion.
5. createFirebaseSceneDocument(elements, pages, roomKey) returns { sceneVersion, ciphertext, iv, pagesCiphertext, pagesIv } (all Bytes.fromUint8Array as today).

6. isSavedToFirebase(portal, elements, pages); saveToFirebase(portal, elements, appState) bails on isSavedToFirebase(portal, elements, appState.pages); a new document is written with transaction.set(docRef, doc) holding all five fields; an existing one reconciles elements as today, reconciles pages = reconcilePages(appState.pages, await decryptPages(prevStoredScene, roomKey)) and writes all five fields with transaction.update(docRef, doc).

7. After the transaction saveToFirebase decrypts the stored document's elements (as today) and pages (decryptPages), sets the version cache from both, and returns { elements, pages }; it returns null where it returns null today.
8. loadFromFirebase returns { elements, pages } | null: elements as today, pages = decryptPages(storedScene, roomKey); it sets the version cache from both.
9. Page names never leave the encrypted pages payload and are never logged.

units.behaviour: Receives, reconciles and applies the page list with the elements, and counts page versions so page-only changes are broadcast and saved.
rules: 1. private getCollabSceneVersion(elements, pages) = getSceneVersion(elements) + getPagesVersion(pages); every place that compared or stored getSceneVersion(elements) (broadcastElements, queueBroadcastAllElements, _reconcileElements, initializeRoom) uses it with excalidrawAPI.getAppState().pages (or the reconciled/loaded pages).
2. private _reconcilePages(remotePages | undefined): when undefined return the local pages unchanged; else reconcilePages(localPages, restorePages(remotePages)).

3. handleRemoteSceneUpdate(elements, pages?) calls updateScene({ elements, appState: pages ? { pages, activePageId: resolveActivePageId(pages, appState.activePageId) } : undefined, captureUpdate: NEVER }); the local activePageId only changes when its page became a tombstone (FR-21).

4. SCENE_INIT and SCENE_UPDATE handlers pass decryptedData.payload.pages through _reconcilePages to handleRemoteSceneUpdate; scenePromise resolves with appState { pages, activePageId } when pages were received.
5. saveCollabRoomToFirebase applies the stored { elements, pages } result through _reconcileElements and _reconcilePages; the beforeunload check passes appState.pages to isSavedToFirebase.
6. initializeRoom returns { elements, appState: { pages, activePageId: resolveActivePageId(pages, null) }, scrollToContent: true } from loadFromFirebase's { elements, pages }.
7. broadcastElements also broadcasts when only the pages version grew; syncElements is unchanged in signature (pages are read from excalidrawAPI.getAppState()).

8. startCollaboration for a new room (no existingRoomLinkData) builds its elements from every page's non-deleted elements, getNonDeletedElements(excalidrawAPI.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted()), so updateScene (NEVER, no appState) and saveCollabRoomToFirebase keep every page; the pending-image mapping and the deleted-element comment stay.
